parts.label: (a)(i)
(a)(ii)
parts.text:
Silicon forms a low boiling point chloride which reacts with water.

Write an equation to show the reaction of the chloride with water.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Draw a three-dimensional diagram showing the shape of the chloride. Give the $\text{Cl}-\text{Si}-\text{Cl}$ bond angle.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text:
Silicon reacts with oxygen to form a high melting point oxide.

• Suggest the formula of the oxide.

• Suggest, in terms of structure, why the oxide has a high melting point whereas the chloride has a low boiling point.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: Element **A** is in the same period as silicon. Element **A** reacts with dilute nitric acid to form a nitrate. This nitrate decomposes on heating to form an oxide.
parts.text: Write an equation for the decomposition of the nitrate.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The oxide of element **A** has a high melting point.

Suggest the structure and bonding present in the oxide of **A**.
